entities.name: Hans Alfred Nieper
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hans Alfred Herbert Eugen Nieper was a controversial German alternative medicine practitioner who devised "Nieper Therapy". He claimed "Nieper Therapy" could treat cancer, multiple sclerosis, and other serious diseases. His therapy has been discredited as ineffective and unsafe.
